rows.question: What is photometrically observed star
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  t.name AS type_name,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z
FROM photoobj p
LEFT JOIN photo_type t
  ON p.type = t.value
WHERE p.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    t.name ILIKE '%STAR%'
  )
ORDER BY p.objid ASC

  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,

rows.question: Find all photometrically observable star that have spectral observations. Retrieve the object id, right ascension, and declination.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH photo_type_star AS (
  SELECT value
  FROM photo_type
  WHERE lower(name) = 'star'
),
-- find specobj rows that reference a photoobj either via bestobjid or (rare) via specobjid = photoobj.objid
spec_photo_matches AS (
  SELECT specobjid, bestobjid
  FROM specobj
  WHERE bestobjid IS NOT NULL
),
photoobj_with_spec AS (
  SELECT p.objid, p.ra, p.dec
  FROM photoobj p
  JOIN photo_type_star pts ON p.type = pts.value
  JOIN spec_photo_matches s ON s.bestobjid = p.objid
  WHERE p.ra IS NOT NULL AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT objid, ra, dec
FROM photoobj_with_spec

rows.question: Show me the object id, right ascension, and declination of photometrically observed star that have spectral observations.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH specobj_has_line_or_spline AS (
  SELECT
    s.specobjid,
    s.bestobjid
  FROM specobj s
  JOIN galspecline g USING (specobjid)
  UNION
  SELECT
    s.specobjid,
    s.bestobjid
  FROM specobj s
  JOIN spplines p USING (specobjid)
)
SELECT
  p.objid AS object_id,
  p.ra    AS right_ascension,
  p.dec   AS declination
FROM photoobj p
JOIN photo_type pt ON p.type = pt.value
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT bestobjid
  FROM specobj_has_line_or_spline
) s ON p.objid = s.bestobjid
WHERE pt.name = 'STAR'

rows.question: Show me the object id, right ascension, declination, and redshift of spectroscopic observed galaxy in a certain area, of which the right ascension is in an unbouded interval of 185 and 186, declination is in an unbouded interval of 15 and 16.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH specobj_basic AS (
  SELECT
    specobjid,
    bestobjid,
    ra,
    dec,
    z,
    class
  FROM specobj
),
photoobj_base AS (
  SELECT
    objid,
    ra,
    dec
  FROM photoobj
),
spectroscopic_source_flags AS (
  SELECT
    s.specobjid,
    CASE WHEN g.specobjid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_galspecline,
    CASE WHEN p.specobjid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_spplines
  FROM specobj AS s
  LEFT JOIN galspecline AS g ON g.specobjid = s.specobjid
  LEFT JOIN spplines AS p ON p.specobjid = s.specobjid
)
SELECT
  s.bestobjid AS object_id,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  s.z AS redshift
FROM specobj_basic s

JOIN spectroscopic_source_flags f ON s.specobjid = f.specobjid
WHERE p.ra > 185
  AND p.ra < 186
  AND p.dec > 15
  AND p.dec < 16
  AND s.class = 'GALAXY'
  AND (f.in_galspecline = 1 OR f.in_spplines = 1)
